annotations.title: Return of capital and tax character

description: How much of an income ETF's distributions were return of capital: the rows its page prints, each with its source, window and date (the issuer's Rule 19a-1 notices, weighted by amount), the annual report's final tax character (Form N-CSR) with its fiscal year and filing date, the comparison of the two where both exist, and the kind of options the fund writes from N-PORT. A notice ETFIQ has not read is never reported as 0%. Facts from filings, not tax advice.

ticker.description: One fund's ticker, such as JEPI.
